2: The foregoing recitals are included within this resolution, as if set forth herein verbatim.
3:
The Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia does hereby adopt the sign permit fees as set out upon the schedule which is attached hereto this resolution, and does specifically acknowledge that said schedule establishes the current sign permit fees as of the effective date of this resolution, and that said schedule establishing the sign permit fees supercedes and replaces all prior schedules for sign permit fees previously set by the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia. However, the adoption of this schedule does not limit the Town of

Clermont’s authority and ability to collect outstanding fees and assessments as to the erection of signs within the Town of Clermont, Georgia and that have accrued prior to the adoption of this current schedule. The Town of Clermont, Georgia shall have the full power and authority to use all of the remedies allowed by its ordinances, or by law, to collect any outstanding fees, assessments, and other charges owed to the Town of Clermont, Georgia.
5:
No provision of this resolution shall be construed as a limitation upon the authority or the discretion of the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia to adopt by a proper resolution, a new schedule or schedules in the future that establish new sign permit fees, in order to meet financing, operational, maintenance and construction needs of the Town of Clermont,

Georgia.
7:
This resolution is effective as of the 5 th day of December , 2006.
